BARCELONA, Nov 22 : Barcelona shook off a sloppy first half to beat Villarreal 3-2 in LaLiga on Sunday. Villarreal raced into a two-goal lead after seven minutes, as Tajon Buchanan and Tani Oluwaseyi took advantage of lax Barcelona play early on. Lamine Yamal won a penalty midway through the first half, but dragged the spot-kick onto the post in the 23rd minute. Gerard Martin headed in a Pedri cross in the 57th minute to reduce the gap, before Fermin Lopez equalised four minutes later.

Barcelona's third followed in quick succession when Villarreal defender Pau Navarro turned Lamine Yamal's cross into his own goal. Navarro was then sent off for a second yellow in stoppage time. Barcelona remain top of the standings on 36 points, three ahead of Real Madrid after Jose Mourinho's side beat Celta Vigo on Saturday. Villarreal remain ninth on 15 points.

Source: Reuters

LAS VEGAS, Nov 22 : Formula One stewards handed Mexican Sergio Perez a five-place grid penalty for next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix after ruling the Cadillac driver caused a collision with Haas' Brazilian rookie Rafael Camara in Las Vegas on Saturday. • Perez would have collected a 10 second penalty but because he had retired from the race it was changed to a grid drop for his next race instead • The stewards said Perez had not earned the right to the corner and was wholly to blame for the lap 18 collision on approaching turn 14 • "I was alongside him and expected him to leave me enough room to make the corner," said Perez. "I was planning to make the move afterwards, into Turn 16, but unfortunately he didn’t see me. By the time I tried to avoid him, it was already too late. He apologised afterwards and explained that he simply hadn’t seen me."

item.title: COP31 climate talks collapse as EU and others reject deal
item.description: The last time UN climate talks failed to get a deal adopted by all parties was in Copenhagen in 2009.

COP31 climate talks collapse as EU and others reject deal

The last time UN climate talks failed to get a deal adopted by all parties was in Copenhagen in 2009.

COP31 President Murat Kurum speaks during the plenary session at the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye on Nov 22, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Murad Sezer)

FAST

ANTALYA: United Nations climate talks collapsed on Sunday (Nov 22) as the European Union and others rejected a final draft deal put forward by COP31 presidents Türkiye and Australia, saying it was too weak to advance the fight against global warming. The failed talks reflect world governments' struggle this year to muster ambitious action to address the worsening consequences of climate change, as wars, economic pressures and other crises compete for their attention. After more than two weeks of negotiations that spilt two days into overtime - making it the longest COP on record - Türkiye's conference president Murat Kurum said at the closing plenary that he could see there was no agreement and confirmed he would not advance any new text. "There is nothing to do, we did all that we could," he said. "There will be no new text from now on."

He later left the stage in the midst of speeches being delivered by country representatives. Australia's COP31 President of Negotiations, Chris Bowen, called the outcome "very disappointing" and said disagreements over fuels and climate finance were the dealbreakers. The last time UN climate talks failed to get a deal adopted by all parties was in Copenhagen in 2009. Ireland's environment minister Darragh O'Brien said the European Union could not support the proposed deal in part because it made no mention of the fossil fuels that scientists say drive global warming. "It is unconscionable that we would have a climate act that makes no reference to fossil fuel, no reference to transitioning away from fossil fuels," he said. Saudi Arabia and other big oil producer countries had lobbied hard to keep their mention out of the text, according to observers at the summit. Panama also said it could not support the text because it failed to address the scale and urgency of the climate crisis. This year's COP is the first since the UN's environmental body in October confirmed the rise in global temperature was set to exceed 1.5°C, a threshold countries agreed at Paris climate talks over a decade ago to try not to exceed, and beyond which extreme weather impacts intensify.

Related:

Fossil fuels still missing from latest COP31 draft deal

OPEC speaks up for fossil fuels at COP31 climate talks

Belgium's Climate Minister Jean-Luc Crucke said the failure of the deal was a difficult outcome, but appropriate. "It's not the end of multilateralism, but there has to be courage to say no," he said. While a blow to efforts to ratchet up international action, the failure to agree on a political declaration in Antalya does not erase the obligations agreed by previous UN conferences or remove the technical and legal frameworks governing multilateral action against climate change. PRESSURE FROM SAUDI ARABIA AND OTHER OIL PRODUCERS The failed deal had acknowledged the planet's projected temperature overshoot and called for faster development of carbon-removal technologies to eventually reverse it. That was a big ask from oil - producing countries. While scientists say removing carbon from the atmosphere - when paired with steep emissions cuts - is vital to avoiding the worst impacts of climate change, critics of the proposed deal said they worried the carbon removal language would be used as a licence to keep pumping oil. A representative for the Saudi delegation, which supported the deal's mention of carbon removal, told the summit at the closing plenary that he was surprised at the resistance to technology, which he said offered a concrete solution. Developing countries had also criticised the deal for not providing sufficient new climate finance to help them adapt to a warming planet. The deal had called for a tripling of such finance, but did not specify from what baseline. The failed deal had also included a goal put forward by Türkiye to expand electricity's share of total final world energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035, from around 23 per cent now. Proponents of that pledge said it could cut greenhouse gas emissions by speeding the transition away from fuel-powered cars, furnaces, and other equipment. But critics said it could force more costs onto poor nations without providing a clear path away from fossil fuels. The COP process is the main vehicle through which countries coordinate their efforts to curb global warming. Its annual meeting provides an opportunity for nations to signal they are willing to work together to find solutions and help finance the problems rising temperatures cause.

Source: Reuters/dc

MANCHESTER, England,, Nov 22 : Manchester City missed out on the chance to move into first place in the Women's Super League on Sunday, suffering a 3-1 defeat at home by Tottenham Hotspur that leaves them second in the standings.  With leaders Chelsea held to a 1-1 draw by Liverpool on Saturday, reigning champions City looked set to capitalise on that slip-up when they took a 1-0 lead thanks to a Bunny Shaw goal in the 10th minute. However, Norwegian striker Cathinka Tandberg levelled for Spurs just before the break.  City stuttered in attack, and they were punished in the 74th minute when Drew Spence sliced them open with a pass through the middle that Matilda Vinberg picked up before slotting into the net, and Jessica Naz added a goal on her 100th WSL appearance shortly afterwards to make it 3-1.  The defeat leaves City on 25 points after 11 games, two behind Chelsea and two ahead of third-placed London City Lionesses, while the win lifts Spurs to fifth on 20 points.  In the day's other early kick-off, Simi Awujo struck deep into second-half stoppage time to give Manchester United a 2-1 win away to Birmingham City to leave them fourth in the table on 21 points.

Source: Reuters

FAST

GURGL, Austria, Nov 22 : Timon Haugan held off compatriot Eirik Hystad Solberg to win the men's World Cup slalom in Gurgl as Norway claimed the top two places on Sunday. Haugan clocked a combined time of one minute 42.55 seconds to finish 0.60 seconds ahead of Solberg, with Switzerland's Tanguy Nef completing the podium, 0.88 behind. "It's a huge relief," Haugan told Viaplay after claiming his seventh World Cup victory and becoming the first Norwegian to win a World Cup race at the Austrian venue. Gurgl joined the World Cup calendar in 2023. Haugan had endured a difficult build-up to the season after discovering he had used the wrong binding setup for much of his preparation.

"It's been one of the toughest pre-seasons I've had, with a lot of doubt and uncertainty. I thought I just had to go for it today. Better to do it now than later," he added. Solberg delivered a strong second run to secure the first World Cup podium of his career. "It doesn't get any more fun than that," Solberg said. Atle Lie McGrath, who trailed Haugan by just one hundredth of a second after the opening run, failed to finish his second descent. Fellow Norwegian Henrik Kristoffersen also went out in the deciding run. Brazil's Lucas Pinheiro Braathen saw his bid to win the opening three races of the season end when he straddled a gate early in the first run. He had won the giant slalom in Soelden and the slalom in Levi.

Source: Reuters

FAST

PORTIMAO, Nov 22 : Ducati's Marc Marquez sealed the 2026 MotoGP crown at the Portuguese Grand Prix on Sunday, his eighth-place finish enough to establish an unassailable lead in the standings and place him alongside the great Giacomo Agostini on eight premier-class titles. Marquez needed to finish in the top nine in Sunday's race and despite starting second on the grid, the Spaniard rode with caution to finish eighth and seal the title with a round to spare. The race was won by Marco Bezzecchi, who held a 102-point advantage over Marquez at one stage this season, while his Aprilia team mate Jorge Martin and Trackhouse rider Raul Fernandez completed the podium. However, all eyes were on Marquez, who marked the occasion by scaling a scaffold to address the cheering fans before watching a big-screen montage of the defining moments of his career.

MARQUEZ, THE 'GOAT' As a final flourish, the Spaniard ascended a staircase accompanied by the silhouette of a goat on the screen, a nod to his growing 'Greatest of All Time' status, before receiving a golden commemorative helmet from Agostini himself. He then attached another plaque with his name engraved on it on the Tower of Champions before embracing and lifting it over his head. "We need to be happy. I know that we are here celebrating a historic moment. I know how I suffered," said an emotional Marquez, who underwent double surgery midway through the season. "I know that in the middle of the season, the fans believed more than I did. My people believed more than I did. But I kept pushing, I kept doing my best. "I said last year that it was a championship where I was at peace with myself. This one is for all the fans that believed in me from 2020 until now. So thanks to all of you, this is for all of you." Marquez came agonisingly close to securing the title in Saturday's sprint but his hopes were dashed when he crashed out on the penultimate lap while running in third place, a finish that would have been sufficient to crown him champion. But unlike Saturday's overcast conditions and spots of rain on the circuit, Sunday's 25-lap race was held in bright sunshine. TOP-NINE FINISH ENOUGH FOR MARQUEZ Martin needed to outscore Marquez by 18 points while the Ducati rider's equation was far more simple: secure a top-nine finish regardless of his rivals' results to get his hands on the trophy. Marquez had been cautious in the sprint but this time he shot off the line to take the lead from polesitter Bezzecchi while several riders jostled for position behind him, with Martin moving up from seventh to fourth. But Marquez was soon swallowed up by the faster Aprilia bikes around him, with the championship leader quickly falling to seventh as he exercised caution amid aggressive overtaking. A crash from Pedro Acosta moved Marquez up to sixth but he had to concede two places to Fabio Di Giannantonio and Ai Ogura, with the Ducati rider happy to open the door to let them pass knowing eighth would be good enough for the title. Up front, Bezzecchi finally moved past Fernandez to take the lead on lap 15 while Martin also found a way past three laps later with an identical overtake to make it a factory Aprilia one-two. On lap 19, Marquez fell to ninth as KTM's Brad Binder nudged him aside to overtake and there was concern from his legion of fans at the Algarve International Circuit, but a crash from Diogo Moreira on the last lap moved Marquez up to eighth. "Super happy about the season, obviously some highs and some lows, but my best season in MotoGP so far," said Bezzecchi, who missed races with his own injuries. "Still a lot of things to improve. But congrats to Marc, he really deserves everything. He's one of the strongest riders in history, so to fight with him is an honour. "Hopefully next year I will fight again and make his life even harder."

Source: Reuters

item.title: アンソロピックＩＰＯ、銀行に異例の制約 競合担当禁止や人数制限
item.description:
Echo Wang Milana Vinn
［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 過去最大規模となった米人工知能（Ａ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックＩＰＯ、銀行に異例の制約　競合担当禁止や人数制限 11/22 22:09 配信

ニューヨークのタイムズスクエアで19日撮影　REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton/File Photo（ロイター） Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 過去最大規模となった米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）。引き受け銀行は巨額の報酬を得たが、ＩＰＯの過程でアンソロピックが異例なほどの制約を銀行側にかけていたことが関係者の話で分かった。アンソロピックと並ぶ大型上場を遂げたスペースＸでも同様な状況だったという。

６月のスペースＸのＩＰＯでは、数カ月にわたる手続きをスペースＸが厳しく管理し、財務などの情報を開示しなかった。このためアドバイザーは業務を進めにくく、銀行の担当者らは不満を募らせた。

社内で「プロジェクト・ランタン」と呼ばれたアンソロピックのＩＰＯでも、銀行側は振り回された。直前の変更や財務見通しの共有の遅れ、慌ただしい書類承認、銀行に対する極めて異例の制約などだ。

関係者によると、アンソロピックは２２社の引受金融機関の一部に対し、案件に携わる要員を４人までに絞り、上級職員を充てるよう指示した。また銀行の一部の幹部に、法的文書への署名を求めた。案件チームの中核メンバーが上場後６カ月間、オープンＡＩ、カーソル、ディープシーク、ハギング・フェイスなどの競合企業と仕事をすることを制限する内容だった。

銀行は日常的に利益相反を管理し、顧客の機密を守っている。ＩＰＯでこれほどの制限を求めるのはまれで、まして銀行担当者個々に求めることは異例という。

＜情報漏えいに神経とがらす＞

こうした銀行に対する制約は、一つに情報漏えいを防ぐことが目的だった。

アンソロピックが米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出した届出書「フォームＳ─１」が公開される４週間近く前に、ロイターはその内容を報じた。

アンソロピックは、案件を引き受けた大半の銀行との情報共有に、通常のＰＤＦではなく「ネットロードショー」と呼ばれるサービスを使った。

ネットロードショーは、誰が文書を閲覧し、どのページを見たかといったアクセスの詳細を記録する。ネットロードショー上の文書には、バンカー個人の名前が透かしとして入った。

その後もＩＰＯ書類に関する報道は続いた。関係者の１人によると、ネットロードショーの利用で銀行側の業務は煩雑になった。文書のコピーを保存できないことなどが理由だ。

アンソロピックは１０日に仮条件を記載した修正届出書「Ｓ─１Ａ」をＳＥＣに提出し、販売活動を始める予定だった。そのためには、シンジケート団の全銀行に草案を送り、承認を得る必要があるが、送付を巡って混乱があり、銀行側に届け出書がＳ─１Ａがネットロードショー経由で送られたのはニューヨーク時間午前２時ごろ。ＳＥＣへの提出に向け、銀行側に、承認のために与えられた時間は数時間しかなかったという。

銀行担当者からは「手続きが複雑な問題だらけで、これまで手掛けたどの案件とも違っていた」との声が出ている。

ＩＰＯを研究するフロリダ大学のジェイ・リッター名誉教授によると、スペースＸとアンソロピックはいずれも交渉により、グリーンシューオプション（追加売り出し）で売却する追加株式について、引受会社に手数料を一切支払わないことを取り付けた。「これらの企業には確かに、引受会社に対して『いつも通りにはいかない』と告げるだけの市場支配力があった」と指摘した。

アンソロピック、および両ＩＰＯで主幹事を務めたゴールドマン・サックスとモルガン・スタンレーはコメントを控えた。

スペースＸはコメント要請に応じなかった。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず アングル：米ナスダック１００、10月に時価総額2兆ドル超消失　ＡＩ巨額投資に厳しい目 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める 11/22(日) 22:09 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 22 : Paris St Germain forward Desire Doue will undergo surgery later this month after suffering a serious right knee injury, the Ligue 1 champions said on Sunday, with no timeline yet set for his return. The 21-year-old France international was carried off in tears towards the end of the first half of PSG's 3-2 victory at Nice on Saturday after rupturing the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) in his right knee. Doue had earlier scored his second league goal of the season, but was injured when his fully extended leg buckled as he turned to shield the ball from Nice midfielder Sofiane Diop, with no contact between the players. The injury is the latest setback for Doue, who missed parts of last season with calf and hamstring problems.

item.title: ＣＯＰ３１が合意採択断念、ＥＵなど反対 化石燃料巡り対立
item.description:
Sarah McFarlane Peter Hobson
［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah McFarlane　Peter Hobson

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催されていた国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが合意文書の新たな草案を公表したが、欧州連合（ＥＵ）などが反対し、採択を断念した。

議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は、閉会の全体会合で、「本文書についてコンセンサス（合意）がないことを認める。従って、これらの決定は採択されなかった」と述べた。「今後、新たな文書は出さない」とも述べた。

前回、合意採択が見送られたのは、２００９年にデンマークで開かれたＣＯＰ１５だ。「コペンハーゲン合意」を全会一致で採択できず、多国間の気候外交にとって打撃となった。

２０２６年下半期のＥＵ議長国アイルランドのダラ・オブライエン環境相は、科学者が地球温暖化の原因と指摘する化石燃料に全く触れていないことなどを理由にＥＵとして合意草案を支持できないと表明した。パナマも、気候危機の規模と緊急性に応えていないとして、草案を支持できないとした。

交渉を主導したオーストラリアと開催国トルコは、合意文書の草案を複数回示し、気候変動の影響を最も受けやすい国々と、化石燃料の生産や消費に経済を頼る国々の間で妥協点を探った。

２２日に示された最終草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認めた上で、上限を超えた分を最終的に元に戻すため、二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）除去技術の開発を急ぐよう求めていた。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

関係者の話では、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国が、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけたという。一方、草案は野心に欠けるという批判が出た。

議長国は、各国が異議を申し立てるための時間を数時間設け、２２日中に全体会合を開き採択を目指していたが、意見の隔たりは埋まらなかった。

FAST

Nov 22 : South Africa have made two changes to their starting XI for the second and final test against Bangladesh in Centurion on Monday, with batter Tony de Zorzi and fast bowler Anrich Nortje included as the home side seek to win the series. Stand-in captain Aiden Markram confirmed the team on Sunday with De Zorzi included in place of regular skipper Temba Bavuma, who has a calf injury. Nortje comes into the side for Dane Paterson. South Africa won the first test by nine wickets, strengthening their position at the top of the World Test Championship table as they look to defend the title they claimed against Australia at Lord’s last year.   Markram said the wicket looks as though it will have pace and bounce as the game goes on.

"This looks like a pretty typical Centurion wicket," he said. "Generally, it can start off on the slower side and it just quickens up throughout the game. "It's known for a bit of pace and bounce, but also known as a venue where you can score big runs if you get in." Markram has stood in for Bavuma before and said the way the team operates will make it easy for him to do so again. "We've worked really well, to be honest," he said. "Temba is still going to be around this week, so I think it's quite a smooth transition, if there even is a transition. "Shuks (coach Shukri Conrad) is obviously really strong in his ways as well, and from my point of view, it's just about trying to carry those good things forward and trying to get a pulse of the game as quickly as you can, assessing conditions as quickly as you can and coming up with plans from there." Bangladesh scored 400 in their first innings at The Wanderers and took the test to the fifth day. Markram praised their application and expects more of the same at Centurion. "They batted well. They made 400 in the first innings, and first-innings runs, especially of that amount, will keep you in the game for quite a long period of time," he said.

Schumer led Democrats to big Senate win. Now, some say they need a new leader

Reuters

22 November, 2026 05:00 pm IST

By Nolan D. McCaskill WASHINGTON, Nov 22 (Reuters) – Chuck Schumer led Senate Democrats through November’s midterm elections that gave them a decisive 56-seat majority. Progressives responded with a collective “thank you, next,” arguing he should now make way for a successor.

Critics say Schumer’s decades in Washington, his age and his close ties to the party establishment make him ill-suited to lead a caucus increasingly shaped by younger, anti-establishment lawmakers.

“We write first to thank you,” leaders of the populist Working Families Party, which backs like-minded Democratic candidates in elections, said in a November 13 letter to Schumer that called for a generational leadership change.

Show Full Article

“If you step aside at the height of a victory you helped secure, you would show voters that the Democratic Party heeded their call for change. The new majority can begin its work united and focused on fighting for the people who elected them.”

The top Democrat in the Senate for the past decade, Schumer, who turns 76 on Monday, has projected confidence that his colleagues will choose to keep him as their leader in a secret vote on December 1.

“I will be elected majority leader,” Schumer, who is strongly favored to win, told reporters matter-of-factly last week.

But in the first contested Senate Democratic leadership race since 1994, the New York senator faces a challenge from Senator Chris Van Hollen, 67. While only modestly younger than Schumer, the Maryland lawmaker and his progressive allies outside the Capitol have cast him as an agent of change.

Van Hollen has said the 2026 results show voters are demanding the party break with the status quo and adopt a bolder approach that gives new voices, including incoming progressive lawmakers, more influence in the caucus.

‘TIME FOR NEW IDEAS’

The Maryland Democrat has run an increasingly public campaign, though the outcome will be determined in private by 56 Senate Democrats. At least 16 Democrats have publicly committed to backing Schumer, while only six have said they will vote for Van Hollen.

“I’m in this to win it,” Van Hollen said on Thursday. “That’s my goal. I think if we want to move forward on an ambitious agenda like this, we need new leadership. We need to change the culture of the Democratic caucus. People need to have more input. Our new members need to be at the table.”

Democrats flipped nine Senate seats in November, including in several states President Donald Trump won by double digits in 2024. Many of the incoming freshmen said during their campaigns that they would oppose Schumer for Democratic leader.

“Do I like Chuck Schumer?” asked Senator-elect Troy Jackson of Maine. “He’s been great, but I do think it’s time for new ideas.”

In an interview last week on CNN’s “State of the Union,” Van Hollen cited a “hunger for change” among Senate Democrats and said two incoming senators won despite Schumer’s efforts to back their primary opponents. He criticized Schumer for aligning with powerful pro-Israel and cryptocurrency interests in those races.

PROGRESSIVES BACK VAN HOLLEN

Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan said Van Hollen stands out because he understands how Washington and the Senate work as a past chair of House and Senate Democrats’ respective campaign arms, and he’s willing to take risks.

“Those two things are what we need right now, and we need to rethink the way we legislate,” he said, pointing to Van Hollen’s trips to advocate for a wrongly deported migrant and to draw attention to Israel’s war in Gaza as examples of his willingness to take risks.

Senator Tim Kaine of Virginia suggested the leadership fight reflected a healthy discussion within the caucus about its future direction. “And there’s nothing wrong with that,” he told Reuters.

Senate Democratic leader is the only unresolved role among Congress’ top four positions. House Democrats last week nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be speaker in the next Congress, where John Thune will continue to lead Senate Republicans and Representative Jim Jordan will succeed Speaker Mike Johnson as the top House Republican.

SCHUMER COULD FACE PRIMARY CHALLENGER IN 2028

Schumer is up for reelection in 2028, and losing the leadership race could make him a more vulnerable target, as ambitious Democrats such as Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez consider running for his seat. A memo from Ocasio-Cortez’s campaign acknowledged she could run for president, Senate or reelection to the House in 2028.

For his part, Schumer has swatted down questions about his future beyond the leadership election.

“I’m focused on 2027 and delivering for the American people,” he said on Wednesday.

(Reporting by Nolan D. McCaskill; Editing by Michael Learmonth and Cynthia Osterman)

Deal or no deal? COP31 climate talks lurch towards an uncertain finish

Reuters

22 November, 2026 05:00 pm IST

Follow Us:

-->

By Sarah McFarlane and Peter Hobson ANTALYA, Turkey, Nov 22 (Reuters) – Two days after the official close of UN climate talks, COP31 presidents Australia and Turkey struggled to win consensus for a deal to advance the fight against climate change, raising the prospect of no deal being reached.

A new draft deal released on Sunday has yet to be approved as countries disagreed over issues including whether the accord should mention the fossil fuels scientists say are driving warming.

“While no one obtained everything they might have desired, everyone can find a place for themselves within this text. That is the very essence of consensus,” COP31 President Murat Kurum told the talks. “I hope that the decision emerging from this hall will demonstrate to the world that multilateralism is still capable of yielding results.”

Show Full Article

If approved, the current deal would acknowledge for the first time that global warming is on course to exceed the 1.5-degree Celsius (2.7-degree Fahrenheit) threshold that countries had sought to preserve, while calling for faster development of carbon-removal technologies to eventually reverse the overshoot.

Ireland’s environment minister Darragh O’Brien said the European Union could not support the proposed deal.

“We will not endorse a decision that does not respond to the science, that disregards the implementation gap, and that actually risks deepening the chasm between global commitments and the action required to correct the overshoot and bring 1.5 degrees back to within reach,” he said.

Panama also said it could not support the current text.

DRAFT OMITS MENTION OF FOSSIL FUELS

The current draft omits mention of fossil fuels and instead includes language referring to a previous COP at which governments agreed to transition away from oil, gas, and coal.

Observers at the venue, where catering outlets and exhibits have already been dismantled, said Saudi Arabia and other big oil-producing nations had pushed hard in negotiations for keeping explicit mention of fossil fuels out of the text, and carbon removal in.

“It seems like we are negotiating with the Saudis,” said Tuvalu’s climate minister, Maina Talia.

A representative for the Saudi delegation declined to comment.

Speaking on condition of anonymity, several delegations raised the prospect of leaving without a deal.

Others said they worried that too many delegations had already left to catch their planes home, making it possible there would not be a quorum for a decision.

“We hope, of course, that we will still reach a decision. But given the last few hours, I’m sceptical that this can still succeed in the short time left, especially since many colleagues have already left,” said Carsten Schneider, Germany’s environment minister.

Jennifer Morgan, former German climate envoy and a senior fellow at The Fletcher School at Tufts University, said: “After the presidency ignored the views of 150 countries and tabled a very weak text, negotiations are on the brink.”

FOSSIL FUELS STICKING POINT

Environmental group 350.org said it was disappointed by the draft’s failure to mention fossil fuels explicitly, as well as its encouragement of carbon-removal technologies.

“Carbon capture is one of the biggest scams of the overshoot era, and our leaders are on the verge of falling for it,” said Sara Shaw, the group’s campaigns and networks director, referring to the practice of trapping carbon dioxide before it reaches the atmosphere.

Critics say the technologies are expensive and unproven at scale, and that including them in a deal is likely to spur continued oil and gas development.

The new draft text followed intensive consultations between Australia, which is leading the talks, Turkey, which is hosting the meeting, and delegations from nearly 200 countries.

The presidency gave delegations several hours to raise any objections to the deal, with a session scheduled later on Sunday to begin approving it.

Australia’s task, supported by Turkey, has been to find a deal that balances the needs of nations most vulnerable to climate change with those whose economies depend on either the production or consumption of fossil fuels.

This year’s COP is the first since the UN’s environmental body confirmed that the rise in global temperature was set to exceed 1.5C, a threshold all countries agreed over a decade ago to try not to exceed, and beyond which extreme weather impacts intensify.

(Reporting by Ali Kucukgocmen, Tuvan Gumrukcu, Ezgi Erkoyun, Sarah McFarlane, Valerie Volcovici, Lewis Jackson, Simon Jessop and Peter Hobson; Writing by William James and Richard Valdmanis; Editing by William Mallard and Barbara Lewis)

Exclusive-Like SpaceX, Anthropic ran an unusual IPO process, chafing some bankers

FILE PHOTO: An Anthropic, PBC (ANT) sign in Times Square on the day Anthropic held its initial public offering (IPO) at the NASDAQ Market site in New York City, US, November 19, 2026. REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton/File Photo

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 22 : For the second time this year, Wall Street bankers and lawyers took home a massive paycheck from a record-setting initial public offering. And for the second time this year, some of them came out of it complaining in private about how the process was riddled with complications and unlike any they had worked on before. With SpaceX’s IPO in June, in which banks earned half a billion dollars in fees, bankers chafed over how tightly the Elon Musk-led company controlled the months-long process and kept financial and other information private, making it hard for advisers to do their jobs.  As Anthropic’s IPO, dubbed internally “Project Lantern”, eclipsed SpaceX on Thursday and bankers took home more than half a billion dollars in fees, several people close to the process listed a litany of problems that had plagued the offering process: a compressed timeline, marred by last-minute changes and delays in sharing financial projections; rushed document approvals; and highly unusual restrictions on bankers and concern about leaks — especially after Reuters reported many details from a draft IPO filing weeks before it was made public. Anthropic, for example, instructed some of its 22 IPO underwriters to limit the number of bankers working on the deal to four, asking the firms to make sure they were senior staff, several people familiar with the matter said. One of the people said the restriction likely came out of fear that information would leak, and that the banks found a way to work around it anyway.

Underlying these complaints is a new power dynamic between technology companies and Wall Street. Companies such as SpaceX, Anthropic — and potentially also OpenAI in the future —  have come to wield enormous power as the transformative potential of artificial intelligence creates a frenzied demand for their shares, and they are wielding it to do things their way. That is upsetting some bankers. But banks and investors appear to have little choice but to play along. “These companies certainly did have some market power to tell underwriters that it’s not going to be business as usual,” said Jay Ritter, a University of Florida professor emeritus who researches IPOs. “But the big Wall Street firms, I suspect, are still going to be doing things as business as usual for all but maybe OpenAI (after these two deals).” Ritter added that both SpaceX and Anthropic had negotiated to pay underwriters nothing on the additional shares sold through the greenshoe option. “I don't think most companies are going to be able to demand zero spread on overallotment shares,” he said. Anthropic, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, the two lead underwriters on the two IPOs, declined to comment. SpaceX and OpenAI did not respond to requests for comment. Both SpaceX and Anthropic debuted successfully, raising record amounts of money, and their shares rallied initially. A key part of the underwriters’ job is to market the securities. Thanks to the demand for AI, that was an easy sell — both companies had order books oversubscribed many times over.  After an initial burst in shares, the trajectories of the two big AI firms diverged. SpaceX climbed to a post-listing peak of $201.80 on June 16 before retreating below its $135 IPO price for the first time in mid-July. Anthropic’s shares closed down 8.5 per cent on Friday after a 17 per cent first-day pop, as a dramatic unraveling of the AI trade showed that even a blockbuster listing could not shake the gloom hanging over the sector. UNUSUAL NON-COMPETES AND RESTRICTIONS In the case of SpaceX’s IPO, the people close to the process said Musk’s team dictated terms at every stage. Musk's team told the largest and most powerful US banks — including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley — how to market SpaceX's stock and to whom. It told some banks the specific order sizes they needed to “fill” — in some cases a few billion dollars — and gave them instructions on what types of investors to bring. Banks signed on to underwrite the IPO without being told what they would be paid, the people said. The underlying current running through Anthropic’s IPO process was what several of the people who spoke to Reuters interpreted as a sense of extreme caution.     Anthropic asked some senior officers at banks working on its IPO to sign legal documents restricting core members of the transaction team from working with rival companies, including OpenAI, Cursor, DeepSeek and Hugging Face, for six months after it went public, according to the people.  Banks routinely manage conflicts and protect client confidentiality. But bankers and lawyers said it is rare for an IPO to impose exclusivity this broad, particularly on individual bankers.  In previous head-to-head IPOs such as those of ridesharing rivals Uber and Lyft, or real estate companies Trulia and Zillow, banks could simply pick a side, in part because the deals were smaller and required fewer banks.  Anthropic, by contrast, needed a broad syndicate to raise the enormous amount of capital it was seeking. That, some of the people said, explained why Anthropic sought to bind individual bankers with these restrictions.  One banker who declined to sign on to the agreement said it was a challenge to find people who could promise not to actively cover or engage with Anthropic’s peers, especially as several of those companies pursue their own initial or secondary offerings.   INFORMATION LEAKS AND LATE NIGHTS  Some of the restrictions were meant to control leaks of information.  Nearly four weeks before Anthropic’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, called Form S-1, was made public, Reuters reported on it, revealing details of the company’s financials, risk factors, dealings with other tech companies and other information.  Anthropic also used a product called NetRoadshow to share information, instead of regular PDFs, with most of the banks underwriting the deal.  NetRoadshow logs access details, including information such as who has seen the document and looked at which page. Documents on NetRoadshow also had individual bankers’ names as watermarks.  Leaks continued to surface in the press, but using NetRoadshow complicated bankers' work, including because the platform would not let them save copies of documents, one of the people said. Anthropic planned to file an updated securities filing, called an S-1A, with the SEC with the price range and to launch the marketing on November 10. To do so, it needed to send a draft to all the banks in its syndicate for them to sign off on it. The night before it was to happen, a law firm on the deal sent a PDF to the banks about the sale of shares in Canada. But soon it followed with another email asking them to disregard it, saying it “contains incorrect price range and share information,” according to the email, which was seen by Reuters.   The correct S-1A was then sent via the NetRoadshow platform around 2 a.m. New York time. Banks were told they had several hours to sign off on it before it was filed with the SEC.

Source: Reuters

Nov 22 : Captain Bruno Fernandes said Manchester United have offered him a new contract but discussions have been put on hold as the club focuses on turning around its poor form. Fernandes' current deal expires at the end of the season, although United hold an option to extend the midfielder's contract by a further year until June 2028, giving the club more time to reach an agreement on fresh terms. "Yeah, the club offered me a new contract, so I think that, from their side, shows that they want me to stay. And as you said, there are no negotiations going on," Fernandes told Sky Sports in an interview published on Sunday. "We spoke about the contract at the end of last season, we came in at the beginning of this season speaking about the contract, but because of the context of the team and the club, I just put that to one side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations.

"The most important thing now is that the club gets back to winning games." The Portugal international also addressed comments claiming he had demanded more money and a longer deal, saying his priority was to remain at Old Trafford and help restore the club's fortunes. United are third from bottom of the Premier League standings, having won only one of their opening 10 league matches, their worst start to a season in 40 years. "I've seen people saying that he's asked for more money, he's asked for more years. If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here. I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United," Fernandes said. "I could have been in a place that's much warmer than Manchester." New manager Mauricio Pochettino, appointed after Michael Carrick was sacked earlier this month, will take charge of his first game when United face fifth-placed Liverpool on Sunday.

Source: Reuters

Nov 22 : England all-rounder Will Jacks has been ruled out of the remainder of the white-ball tour of Australia after suffering a broken hand, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Sunday. • The 28-year-old sustained the injury while attempting a caught-and-bowled chance off Ben Dwarshuis during Australia's three-wicket victory in the opening Twenty20 International in Melbourne on Saturday. • England have not yet named a replacement for Jacks, who had been earmarked to captain the side in the fifth and final T20 in Canberra on December 2, with regular skipper Harry Brook set to leave the tour early to prepare for England's trip to South Africa. • Australia lead the five-match series 1-0 with the second match set to be played on Tuesday in Queensland.

Source: Reuters

LAS VEGAS, Nov 22 : Ferrari principal Fred Vasseur said Charles Leclerc's collision with teammate Lewis Hamilton at the Las Vegas Grand Prix on Saturday was "completely unacceptable". The incident came weeks after the Ferrari pair had collided at the Mexico City race, prompting talks within the team aimed at preventing a repeat. Vasseur said the latest clash was particularly frustrating given Ferrari had addressed the issue with both drivers after Mexico and again in Brazil. Leclerc received a 10-second penalty over the incident and finished 10th, while Hamilton, who was penalised for an earlier incident, finished seventh.

"Clearly it's unacceptable, first," Vasseur told Sky Italia. "A bit the same message as Mexico because you have to think about the team, about the people working in Maranello, about all the stakeholders, sponsors." Leclerc had attempted to pass his teammate on the inside during the latter stages of the race but the pair made contact that spun Hamilton around. "Charles did clearly make a mistake, that is penalising the team a lot and it's completely unacceptable today," Vasseur said. "We had a chat all together in Brazil. Today we passed the message to think about the team when they were racing together and the outcome is this one. It's mega-frustrating for all of us." Leclerc said he accepted responsibility as the stewards had decided to penalise him. "I've been penalised so as a result I guess the majority and the stewards thought that it was my mistake, which I'll accept," the Monegasque driver added. "I'm not going to say much more. At the end of the day I'm penalised so it has to be my mistake. "I just feel quite embarrassed for the team in general. We will review." Hamilton was reluctant to discuss the clash with Leclerc. "I'm not going to get into the scenario. That's something for you to speak to Ferrari about," Hamilton said. "But we knew that we were faced with a massive challenge this weekend. We didn't realise there would be such a limitation on the straights, and qualifying obviously was difficult. "In the race I felt great and I really was progressing well. We ultimately wanted to try and make sure we finished ahead of the McLarens because that's who we're really fighting in the constructors." Hamilton was penalised on lap 12 for leaving the track and gaining an advantage while passing McLaren's Lando Norris. The seven-times world champion was unable to give the position back and said the sanction was harsh. "Avoiding collision with one of the McLarens got me a 10-second penalty, which was, I think, really harsh," he said. "I got my head back down and just kept chasing, managed to get back in the fight and then got knocked back again. "But I never gave up and was just trying to get the best result. I really think we could have had a podium today with the pace we had." Asked whether Ferrari needed firmer internal rules for racing Hamilton said that was a matter for the team. "That's for Ferrari to decide, honestly," he said. "I've done all I can and I've said everything and more. It's been difficult. So all I can do is just show up and give it everything I can and hope in the background they eventually figure it out."

Source: Reuters

LAS VEGAS, Nov 21 : McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri said they were pleased to put last year's double disqualification at the Las Vegas Grand Prix behind them after finishing second and third on Saturday. Norris had started from pole position and finished second in Las Vegas last year, while Piastri crossed the line fourth, but both were later disqualified for excessive skid plank wear. On Saturday, Norris and Piastri followed home race winner Max Verstappen, with Piastri joking that he would save his celebrations until the final technical checks were complete. "I don't know if we're past scrutineering yet. I'm hoping we have," the Australian told reporters. "No, it's good. And yeah, in the context of this year's championship it's exactly what we needed.

"So I'm very happy about that. But yeah, I'm not going to solidify my comments until we have actually passed scrutineering." McLaren won the constructors' championship last year but are fourth this season, nine points behind Red Bull in third. Mercedes have already sealed the constructors' championship, ahead of Ferrari in second place. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli won the drivers' championship earlier this month. Norris is fifth in the standings, on the same points total as Mercedes driver George Russell, while Piastri is seventh. Norris said what happened in Las Vegas last year had been consigned to history and that McLaren had not arrived in Nevada looking to make up for that disappointment. "What happened last year happened last year, so it's not like you come here to try and make up for what happened," he added. "It was a freak thing that shouldn't have happened. Didn't gain us an advantage, it was just unfortunate. "So yeah, it's a separate year and I'm happy that we just finished any race to be honest."

LAS VEGAS, Nov 21 : Red Bull's Max Verstappen laughed at George Russell's misfortune on Saturday after the Dutchman won the Las Vegas Grand Prix while his Mercedes rival went into the barriers and finished ninth. Russell had challenged Verstappen for the lead but ended up fighting to salvage something after the late drama in a chaotic Formula One race of slipstreaming and nose-to-tail action. The pair, who are vying for the runners-up spot in the drivers' standings behind Mercedes' new champion Kimi Antonelli, have clashed repeatedly over the years, on and off track. They made contact in final practice in Las Vegas that landed Verstappen with a stewards' warning, while Russell accused the Dutchman on Friday of trying to "screw me over" and vowed to stand up to him.

"He speaks a lot next to the track," Verstappen told the post-race press conference of Russell. "It doesn't really bother me because he's so far below my level that it doesn't really make any sense for me to try and challenge that. "And today karma is a bitch. It was honestly fantastic when I looked in my mirror and I saw what was happening. "So I was like 'fantastic. My day's only getting better'." Canada's 1997 world champion Jacques Villeneuve, a pundit for Sky Sports television, winced at the comments. "The comments are there to hurt, to put in his terms George in place," he said. "From the outside you just have to laugh and find the fun in the words that are being used." Russell said he had no regrets about the move that left him in the barriers. "I felt like I had to go for it if I wanted to win the race," he added. "In a race like this it was sort of high risk, high reward and with two laps remaining I kind of really wanted to be behind Max going into that last lap and obviously just got it very slightly wrong, and with the lockup it was unavoidable. "So obviously disappointed and a bit frustrated with it." (Writing by Alan Baldwin in London; Editing by Peter Rutherford)

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＣＯＰ３１議長国が合意文書の新草案、脱化石燃料に直接言及せず 合意不透明
item.description:
Tuvan Gumrukcu Ali Kucukgocmen
［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Ali Kucukgocmen

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催中の国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが合意文書の新たな草案を公表した。各国の代表団が異議を申し立てられるよう数時間の猶予を設定した。合意案の承認手続きを始める会合を２２日中に開く予定だが、先行きは不透明。合意に至らない可能性も出ている。

新草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認める。その上で、超過分を最終的に押し戻すため、炭素除去技術の開発加速を求める。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

協議に詳しい関係筋によると、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国は、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけていたという。

ツバルのマイナ・タリア気候変動相は「まるでサウジと交渉しているようだ」と話した。 サウジ代表はコメントを控えた。

ＣＯＰ３１の議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は「われわれは、全ての締約国が合意できる文案を提示できたと考えている。妥協が見えてきている」と述べた。

しかし匿名を条件に取材に応じた複数の代表団は、合意しないまま会議を終える可能性に言及した。

環境団体「３５０．ｏｒｇ」は、草案が化石燃料に明示的に言及せず、炭素除去技術の推進を訴えている点に失望を表明。団体の幹部、サラ・ショー氏は「炭素回収はオーバーシュート時代で最大級の詐欺で、われわれの指導者はそれにだまされる寸前だ」と批判した。

二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）を大気中に放出される前に取り込む炭素回収技術については、費用がかさむうえに大規模な実用化が実証されておらず、合意に盛り込めば石油・ガス開発の継続に道を開くことになるとの批判的な指摘も出ている。

item.title: Washington governor, union denounce ICE arrests of travellers at Seattle airport
item.description: The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport.The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people board
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Washington governor, union denounce ICE arrests of travellers at Seattle airport

A person holds a sign as people gather for a protest at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers arrested two people boarding an Alaska Airlines flight earlier in the day, in SeaTac, Washington, US on Nov 21, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/David Ryder)

FAST

The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport. The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles. ICE officers conducted an operation to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, who overstayed his visa, the agency said in a statement. The officers also arrested a second individual, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, who threw hot coffee at them, ICE said in a post on social media. Mejia had also overstayed her visa, ICE said, adding that she would be charged with assaulting a federal officer. Reuters was not able to identify lawyers for Mendoza or Mejia.

"ICE is completely and totally out of control and today we are confronted with yet more evidence of this," said Governor Bob Ferguson, a Democrat, at a news conference on Saturday. Video of the incident circulated on social media and news outlets is "horrific" and "chilling", Ferguson said, adding that he told Alaska Airlines representatives that “they need to call on ICE to get out of our airports." The governor said he would make the same request of every other airline that flies out of Sea-Tac airport. Alaska Airlines said it is "concerned" by the federal action. "Alaska Airlines was not provided advance notice of the enforcement action and we are working to understand the circumstances surrounding what occurred," the company said in a statement. April Sims, president of the Washington State Labor Council called the ICE arrest a "smash-and-grab" action that injected fear and chaos during a delicate time for air travel. "Just days after our nation experienced widespread disruptions to air travel and flights being grounded, federal agents chose to carry out this operation at one of our busiest airports, during one the busiest travel weeks of the year," Sims said in a statement sent by the union, which includes local chapters representing flight attendants and ground crew at Sea-Tac airport. Alaska Airlines said many passengers were put on other flights shortly after the incident and the originally scheduled flight departed at 11am.

Source: Reuters/nh

item.title: ＥＵ加盟国はロシア人の入国制限強化を、デンマークが提案 暗殺未遂受け
item.description:
John Irish
[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - デンマークは、米ウクライナ二重国籍の男性ラッパーに対するロシアの暗殺計画を阻止したと発表したのに続き、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に文書を送り、ロシア国民への入国制限を強化するよう呼びかけた。外交関係者が文書の内容を確認した。

デンマークの警察と治安当局は２０日、ロシア情報機関が９月下旬にコペンハーゲンで公演を控えていた男性ラッパーの暗殺を企てたが、直前に関係する３人を逮捕したと明らかにした。ラスムセン外相はこれを「容認できない」と非難し、デンマーク政府はロシアの駐在武官の国外追放も発表した。

デンマークはＥＵ加盟国の外交担当者に２０日夜に送った文書で、欧州域内の自由な往来を保障するシェンゲン協定締結２９カ国への入国に関し、ロシア国民への観光ビザ（査証）の発給停止や、ロシアの非生体認証パスポートでの本人確認を停止することを提案した。

週明け２３日に開かれるＥＵの事務レベルの会議で提案を示す見通し。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝クリッパーズ3連敗、八村19得点8リバウンドも及ばず
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は２１日、各地で試合を行い、八村塁が所属するクリッパーズはマーベリックスに１００─１１０で敗れた。

先発した八村は約２９分プレーし、１９得点、８リバウンド、１アシストだった。クリッパーズは３連敗。

セブンティシクサーズはバックスを１３２─１２９で下し、５連勝。東カンファレンストップの１４勝３敗とした。シクサーズのジョエル・エンビードが２６得点、１７リバウンド、９アシストと活躍。レブロン・ジェームズが２１得点、６リバウンド、６アシスト、３スチールで貢献した。バックスはタイラー・ヒーローがキャリア最多の５０得点を挙げたが、１３連敗となった。

スパーズはビクター・ウェンバンヤマが５０得点、１９リバウンドと活躍し、ペリカンズに１１４─９１で快勝した。ティンバーウルブズはグリズリーズに１０４─９５で勝利。ニックスはトレイルブレーザーズに９７─９６で競り勝った。

item.title: Wall Street asks what can save AI trade after Anthropic wipeout
item.description: Wall Street is struggling to find reasons to buy as the AI trade comes under pressure following Anthropic’s lacklustre post-IPO performance. A sharp selloff in tech stocks, mounting concerns over AI-related risks and an expected Federal Reserve rate hike have dampened investor sentiment, leaving markets searching for fresh catalysts to revive the rally.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: It’s been a tough month for the stock market, rocked by back-to-back punches from the stunning ouster of Jensen Huang from Nvidia Corp. and the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterm elections.Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering this week was supposed to provide some relief and change the mood. It didn’t. Instead, it raised more questions about the struggling artificial intelligence trade, and tech stocks continued to sell off, led by chipmakers, with Nasdaq 100 Index tumbling 10% for the week, its worst performance since the Covid pandemic hit in March 2020.Now, with few positive catalysts and a series of obvious risks on the horizon, starting with the Federal Reserve’s expected interest-rate hike next month, Wall Street is wondering what will inspire stocks to start climbing again. Instead of finding inspiration to buy, investors just keep discovering reasons to sell, as seemingly every other news headline — from air travel shutdowns to financial hacks — fuels suspicion that technology isn’t adapting to the risks posed by AI.“The market is in limbo-land, especially when it comes to tech and AI,” said Paul Nolte, market strategist and senior wealth manager at Murphy & Sylvest Wealth Management. “You need to gird your loins and expect a period of volatility and downside risk.”136067477The Anthropic deal could mark the end of the AI trade, Anna Wong, an economist with Bloomberg Economics, wrote in a report on Thursday. The company’s financials show weakening pricing power for frontier intelligence, she wrote, meaning that even with all the demand for AI services, leading providers are having trouble getting customers to pay enough for it to justify their spending.Of course, in a vacuum, Anthropic’s IPO did fine. It was priced over its targeted range, and when combined with a separate private placement of shares, the company raised the most cash for a new issue ever, topping SpaceX’s deal in June. The stock even raced higher out of the gate. But it quickly plateaued and then started retreating. By the end of Friday it was less than $6 from where it went public.The bigger issue is it ushered in more selling rather than giving investors a reason to buy. By the end of Friday, the Nasdaq 100 was teetering on the brink of bear market, defined as a 20% decline from a recent high, while the S&P 500 Index had entered a correction after falling 12% from its October record.Skeptical TimesAll that selling laid bare the magnitude of the questions swirling around AI more than four years into a bull market powered by huge bets on the technology.“There was a hope that the Anthropic IPO would provide a sustained boost, but the trading there is indicative of the broader concerns surrounding AI,” said Jim Baird, chief investment officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors. “Anthropic came to market at a time of more general skepticism surrounding the space, and there are a lot of questions about their ability in the near term to deliver on increasingly lofty expectations.”Democratic victories in the midterms raised the risk that data center construction will slow since many of the party’s candidates ran on blocking their development. Meanwhile, the risk of higher interest rates raises the cost of capital as big data center developers increasingly turn to credit markets for funding.“A lot of the growth in AI is dependent on how and whether companies can fund their capital needs,” said Malcolm Polley, director of strategic market analysis at Stratos Investment Management, which has $3.6 billion in assets. “Will they need to fund that through capital or debt markets? Until we know the cost of capital, we can’t adequately value the asset, and if the cost of capital is going higher, then valuations need to come down.”But it’s the chaos at Nvidia that really has spooked investors. The company ousted Huang on Nov. 12 after he admitted having an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, and the stock has been in a tailspin ever since. Even a strong earnings report featuring a raised revenue forecast for next fiscal year and a $150 billion stock buyback authorization couldn’t stop the selling, as the question remained who will be Huang’s permanent replacement.Nvidia shares plunged 23% this week, their worst performance since 2008. The stock is down 48% from an Oct. 6 all-time high.The turmoil appeared to create openings for Nvidia’s competitors, including chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices Inc. But that bet took a hit on Thursday when a short seller raised questions about AMD’s business in China, which could be hurt by more US chip export restrictions. The shares plunged 20% in the final two sessions of the week.More broadly, it’s the sustainability of the hundreds of billions of dollars being spent to expand computing power that’s driving the selloff. That spending has juiced earnings for companies across the AI ecosystem, from chipmakers and networking gear manufacturers to electricity providers and industrial companies. But investors are increasingly skeptical that it can last.Chip Stocks SwingThis rapid swing from greed to fear is best seen in the trading of semiconductor stocks this year. Chips are historically a cyclical business, rising with demand and then falling as it dissipates. But the belief was that this history would be rewritten as years of AI demand would break the cycle. The Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index more than doubled in the first half of the year on that bet. But it has lost 41% in the second half as investors rethink those positions.136067484Memory and storage stocks, which also are major beneficiaries of the AI spending, have been among the hardest hit over the last few months. Sandisk Corp. was leading the S&P 500 in the first six months of year, soaring 857%. It’s the worst stock in the index in the second half, dropping 72%. Western Digital Corp. has tumbled more than 65% from a June record, while Micron Technology Inc. is down more than 50% from its all-time high.Of course, some optimism remains on Wall Street. In particular the hope is the selloff is nearing exhaustion as investors have used the opportunity to reduce risk, according to Brian Smedley, chief investment officer and head of Cynosure Strategies, the hedge fund division of the Cynosure Group.“I think investors will gain confidence that AI demand remains exceptionally strong, and that the key players — Anthropic among them — will continue to have very healthy growth prospects,” he said. “The market has overshot to the downside, just as it overshot to the upside earlier this year.”One thing investors agree on is that Anthropic’s debut will provide a new level of visibility into the business of selling AI services.“It has been hard to get a real feel for AI demand, and Anthropic is the answer to that question,” said Marta Norton, chief investment strategist at Empower. “We will know more about the upside of AI, in terms of demand and the return, at the same time that we will be getting a reinforced view of how crazy wildly expensive it is.”In the meantime, strategists are advising clients to stay nimble.“It’s hard to say what it might take to catalyze gains after this week,” said Mark Luschini, chief market strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott. “I want to see whether this selloff metastasizes into something more severe. We’re oversold, but not deeply so. We could plumb lower still. I want to see stabilization before I make a strong commitment.”

item.title: テニス＝ＡＴＰファイナル、決勝はズベレフ対アルカラス
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの今季ツアー最終戦、ＡＴＰファイナルは２１日、イタリアのトリノで準決勝を行い、決勝は世界ランキング１位のアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と世界３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）という顔合わせになった。

ズベレフは第４シードでロシア出身のダニル・メドベージェフと対戦し、第１セットはタイブレークで７ポイントを連取して７─６でものにすると、第２セットは６─４で勝利。今大会では１セットも落とさずに決勝まで進んだ。

自身３回目のＡＴＰファイナル制覇を目指すズベレフは「どちらも信じられないほど素晴らしいサーブを打っていたので、（ブレークポイントは）ほとんどなかったような気がする。彼（メドベージェフ）をたたえたい」と話した。

アルカラスは第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）に３─６、６─３、７─６で逆転勝利。「第２セットでいいプレーをして巻き返せたのがとにかくうれしい。タイブレークでも素晴らしいテニスができて満足している。この勝利には大きな意味がある。明日が楽しみだ。今日は全てに満足している」と話した。

アルカラスは優勝すればＡＴＰファイナル初タイトル。ズベレフとの対戦成績は７勝６敗としており、ことしの全豪オープン準決勝でもフルセットの末に勝利を収めている。

item.title: サッカー＝レアル、エムバペＰＫ失敗もセルタに逆転勝ち
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２１日、各地で試合を行い、レアル・マドリードがセルタに２─１で勝利し、翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと暫定ながら勝ち点３３で並んだ。

前半６分に失点したレアルは、同３９分にキリアン・エムバペが自ら得たＰＫで同点のチャンスを得るも、これを失敗。同選手がレアルとフランス代表での試合中にＰＫを外したのは直近６回中これが３回目となった。

レアルは後半２１分、エムバペのアシストからジュード・ベリンガムが同点弾をマークすると、同４０分にカルロス・エスピが決勝ゴールを決めた。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアはラヨ・バリェカノに１─０で勝利し、暫定１７位に浮上して降格圏内を脱出。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

その他、セビリアとベティスのダービーは１─１のドロー。アラベスはデポルティボに３─１で勝利した。

item.title: ノルディックスキー＝Ｗ杯ジャンプ個人第1戦で小林陵8位、丸山9位
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - ノルディックスキーのワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）ジャンプは２１日、リレハンメルで男女の個人第１戦（ヒルサイズ＝ＨＳ１４０メートル）を行い、男子では小林陵侑が８位だった。

小林は１回目に１３５メートル、２回目に１２６．５メートルを飛び、合計２４４．２点だった。シュテファン・エンバハー（オーストリア）が合計２７８．０点で優勝した。中村直幹は１１位、佐藤幸椰は２３位。二階堂蓮は２回目に進めず、３７位に終わった。

女子では丸山希が合計２１６．８点で９位。宮嶋林湖は１１位、勢藤優花は１４位、伊藤有希は１９位で、高梨沙羅は２回目に進めずに３５位だった。優勝したアイリンマリア・クバンダルを含め、５位までノルウェー勢が独占した。

item.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
item.description: Anthropic’s shares fell about 9% after their market debut, deepening concerns over stretched AI valuations and showing that even a marquee listing has not revived investor enthusiasm for the sector. The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic's post-listing slide deepened the gloom over the AI sector on Friday, underscoring how even one of the most eagerly anticipated listings in history has struggled to revive investor enthusiasm.Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain momentum after a turbulent stretch.But the stock was last trading at $88.87, about 9% below where it closed following Thursday's smooth debut, giving Anthropic a fully diluted valuation of about $1.6 trillion and a market capitalization of $1.2 trillion based on shares outstanding.The stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares by year-end.Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained. We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results, said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation assumes years of rapid growth. The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 2% each in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped more than 1%.Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down 7% each and Intel losing more than 5%.The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.PARALLELS WITH SPACEXAnthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX , which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing. There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade, said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.SpaceX shares fell about 5%.Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility. It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment, said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.Competition could also weigh on investor sentiment.Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on behalf of users, entering a market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.

item.title: ラグビー＝ネーションズ選手権、日本はスコットランドに大敗
item.description: ［エディンバラ ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ - ラグビーの強豪１２カ国・地域で争う国際大会、ネーションズ選手権は２１日、英国のエディンバラなどで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同６位のスコットランド代表に５─６７で大敗した。

日本はスピードとパワーで圧倒され、合計１１トライを献上。前半に０─２９と大差をつけられると、後半にも失点を重ね、松永拓朗による１トライにとどまった。

同大会では北半球と南半球のチームが戦い、南の一員として参戦している日本は１勝５敗で５位。北のスコットランドは４勝２敗で４位となった。

エディー・ジョーンズ・ヘッドコーチ率いる日本は１１月に入って３戦全敗。７日はウェールズに２１─２８で敗れ、１４日はイングランドに１５─７８の完敗を喫していた。

item.title: サッカー＝坂元が強烈ミドルで今季2点目、コベントリーがパレス下す
item.description: ［マンチェスター（英国） ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２１日、各地で試合を行い、坂元達裕がフル出場したコベントリーが鎌田大地フル出場のクリスタルパレスに３─２で競り勝った。

コベントリーは１─１と追い付かれて迎えた前半３０分、ペナルティーエリアの外でボールを受けた坂元が胸トラップから左足で強烈なミドルシュートをたたき込み、リーグ戦今季２ゴール目。チームは同アディショナルタイムに再び同点とされたが、最後は相手のオウンゴールで勝利を収めた。

最下位のクリスタルパレスはこれで今季８敗目。トーマス・フランク監督の初陣を白星で飾ることができなかった。クリスタルパレスの冨安健洋はベンチ外。

田中碧が先発したリーズはチェルシーを４─１で撃破。前半２５分に先制されたが、ノア・オカフォーの２ゴールなどで逆転勝利を収めた。チェルシーはリーグ戦直近４試合で３敗目となった。田中は後半４１分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはサンダーランドとスコアレスドローに終わった。前田大然が先発し後半１１分までプレーしたイプスウィッチは、トットナムに０─２で完敗した。

アーセナルはニューカッスルと２─２の引き分けに終わり、勝ち点を積み上げるチャンスを逸した。マンチェスター・シティーはフラムと１─１のドローで試合を終え、リーグ戦４連敗を免れた。

１１試合消化時点で首位アーセナルは勝ち点２８。リーズは同１７として６位に浮上した。コベントリーは同１２で１３位となった。

item.title: フィギュア＝フィンランディア杯、男子の友野は3位 セレブコ初優勝
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、男子では友野一希が合計２３７．７５点で３位に入った。

前日のショートプログラム（ＳＰ）で５位だった友野は、この日に行われたフリーでは４位だった。

ミハイル・セレブコ（エストニア）がＳＰに続き、フリーでも１位となり、合計２５４．９９点でＧＰ初優勝を達成。ファイナル進出を決めた。アンドレアス・ノルデバック（スウェーデン）がＳＰ同様、フリーでも３位となり、合計２４０．９４点の２位だった。

item.title: メキシコ、麻薬組織の首領を拘束 米当局が協力
item.description:
Sarah Kinosian
[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] - メキシコ当局は２１日、軍が２０日夜に麻薬組織の首領ファウスト・イシドロ・メサフロレス容疑者（通称エル・チャポ・イシドロ）を北西部シナロア州で拘束したと発表した。容疑者は米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）の最重要指名手配者１０人の一人。

メキシコ国防省はＸへの投稿で、軍の特殊部隊と国家警備隊による拘束作戦には米国の情報機関も協力したと明らかにした。メキシコ政府はトランプ米政権の圧力を受け、麻薬組織の取り締まりを強化している。

米国務省によると、メサフロレス容疑者とその麻薬組織「ベルトラン・レイバ」は２０年以上にわたり、ヘロイン、メタンフェタミン、コカイン、マリフアナ（大麻）を米国へ大量に密輸してきた。内部抗争が起きている別の麻薬組織「シナロア・カルテル」の派閥の一つと協力関係にあるという。

米国土安全保障捜査局（ＨＳＩ）はＸで、この作戦が「メキシコで最も強力なカルテルネットワークの一つに重大な打撃を与えた」と投稿。米北方軍もメキシコ軍を称えた。

item.title: Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks
item.description: The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks

The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.

Visitors walk in front of Matam Rajab in downtown Manama, Bahrain, Nov 6, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. (File photo: REUTERS/Hamad I Mohammed)

Bahrain said on Saturday (Nov 21) that an Iranian attack had hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched a missile-and-drone attack on US military positions in the kingdom, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February. Since then, Gulf Arab states have been drawn into the conflict, and there have been repeated Iranian attacks across the region. Civil Defence teams were working to contain the fire at the industrial facility, the ministry said in a post on X. It gave no details on the location or nature of the site. Bahrain's interior ministry initially issued an alert urging residents to move to the nearest safe location because of a potential threat, without providing details. It later issued an all-clear before sending a second alert.

Later, Bahrain's Defence Force said its air defences had intercepted a number of Iranian aerial attacks. Shrapnel from the interceptions caused material damage but no casualties, it said, adding that Tehran was continuing its "systematic hostile approach" towards the kingdom. The Revolutionary Guards, in a statement carried by Iranian state news agency IRNA, said their aerospace forces had launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases "in retaliation for ongoing aggression and repeated violations of Iranian airspace". US Central Command did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the Guards' account. Bahrain has reported intercepting several Iranian aerial attacks in recent days. Gulf Arab states have come under repeated fire from Tehran since the war broke out.

item.title: ゴルフ＝ＣＭＥツアー選手権、吉田が首位と1打差の2位に浮上
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフの今季最終戦、ＣＭＥツアー選手権は２１日、フロリダ州ネープルズのティブロンＧＣ（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、吉田優利が２位に浮上した。

３位でスタートした吉田は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６６をマーク。通算１７アンダーの１９９に伸ばし、単独首位の金阿林（韓国）とは１打差につけた。

岩井明愛は５バーディー、ノーボギーの６７でラウンドし、通算１５アンダーの６位に浮上。山下美夢有も６７で回り、通算１４アンダーの７位に順位を上げた。

竹田麗央は通算１２アンダーの１５位。西郷真央と古江彩佳は通算８アンダーの２６位。西村優菜は通算６アンダーの３３位。岩井千怜と勝みなみは３７位、原英莉花と畑岡奈紗は４４位となった。

item.title: Ｆ１＝ラスベガスＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンがＰＰ獲得
item.description: ［ラスベガス ２０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ラスベガス　２０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第２１戦、ラスベガス・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）がポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

総合優勝４回を誇るフェルスタッペンのＰＰ獲得は今季３回目で、キャリア通算５１回目。

すでに史上最年少での総合優勝を決めているキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が最速タイムを計測したが、エンジン関連のペナルティーで５グリッド降格し、決勝では６番手からスタートする。

これを受けて、２番手のフェルスタッペン、３番手のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）、４番手のランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）、５番手のアイザック・ハジャー（フランス、レッドブル）、６番手のアービッド・リンドブラッド（英国、レーシングブルズ）がそれぞれ１つずつ繰り上がる。

item.title: フィギュア＝フィンランディア杯、女子の島田2連勝でファイナル進出
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、女子では島田麻央が第２戦のスケートカナダに続く２連勝を達成。シリーズ上位６人で争われるＧＰファイナル（中国・重慶で１２月１０─１２日に開催）初進出を決めた。

ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）首位の島田は、この日のフリーでは冒頭のトリプルアクセル（３回転半ジャンプ）に成功。さらにステップやスピンで最高難度のレベル４を獲得するなどし、合計２２９．４９点をマークした。

日本選手によるＧＰデビューからの２連勝は２０１８年の紀平梨花以来で、２人目となった。今季ＧＰシリーズでは日本勢が５戦全勝。第１戦と第４戦では中井亜美、第３戦では千葉百音が優勝した。

ニーナ・ペトロキナ（エストニア）が合計２１４．０６点で２位、イザボー・レビト（米国）が合計２０７．１９点で３位に入った。住吉りをんは７位、渡辺倫果は１０位に終わった。

item.title: イラン、バーレーンの工業施設攻撃、2人負傷 「米軍施設標的」と革命防衛隊
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - バーレーンは２１日、民間の工業施設がイランの攻撃を受け火災が発生したと発表した。イランの精鋭部隊、イスラム革命防衛隊は、バーレーン国内の米軍陣地に対しミサイルと無人機による攻撃を実施したと表明した。

バーレーンには米海軍第５艦隊が拠点があり、ここ１週間、イランの攻撃を複数回受けている。

バーレーン内務省は２２日、前日のイランによる攻撃で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。パキスタン人が重体でバーレーン市民は容体は安定していると説明した。

同省は２１日、具体的内容には触れず、潜在的な脅威があるとして住民に避難を呼びかける警報を発令。警報はいったん解除されたが、再び出された。

その後、バーレーン国防軍は、防空部隊がイランによる複数の空中攻撃を迎撃したと発表した。迎撃による破片で物的被害が出たものの、死傷者の報告はないとした。国防軍は、イラン政府がバーレーンに対する「組織的な敵対的アプローチ」を続けていると指摘した。

一方、イランの革命防衛隊は国営イラン通信（ＩＲＮＡ）が伝えた声明で、「継続的な侵略とイラン領空への度重なる侵犯に対する報復」として、リファー基地およびアワリ基地の米軍施設に対し、宇宙航空部隊がミサイルと無人機による複合攻撃を実施したと発表した。

米中央軍は、革命防衛隊の説明に関するロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

item.title: ロシア貨物船に無人機攻撃、ウクライナ関与か フィンランド領海で火災
item.description:
Essi Lehto
［ヘルシンキ ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシア軍と関係のあるロシアの貨物船が２１日、バルト海で無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受けて火災を起こした。フィンランド沿岸警備隊は２２日、消火活動が行われているものの夜間を通じて燃え続けていると発表した。フィンランド軍は、攻撃はウクライナが実行した可能性が高いとの見解を示している。

貨物船は「スパルタ２」。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ロシア国防省向けに物流サービスを提供しているロシアの海運会社オボロンロジスティカが所有する。米国の制裁対象になっている。

フィンランド軍によると、スパルタ２はロシア領ゴーグラント島の西の公海上で攻撃を受けて損傷し、フィンランド領海内に漂流した。現在も領海内でいかりを下ろしている。乗組員１６人は近くにいたロシア船に避難した。

ウクライナは今年に入り、ロシア北西部レニングラード州に向けて軍用無人機による波状攻撃を繰り返している。一部の無人機はバルト海地域の領空に入り込み、戦争が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の領域に影響を及ぼしているとの懸念が出ている。

オルポ首相はＸに「戦争が近隣地域に波及しつつある。フィンランド当局は、無人機攻撃でロシアの商船が被弾したフィンランド湾の状況に対応している。ウクライナには侵略者と戦う権利がある」と投稿した。

エストニアのミハル首相はＸに「ロシアの侵略と戦うことの影響がバルト海に及んだ。侵略者に（侵略を）やめるよう求める新たなシグナルだ。だが、われわれのウクライナ支援を止めるものは何もない」と投稿した。

エストニア海軍司令官のイボ・バルク氏は２２日、フィンランド湾でさらなる攻撃が行われるリスクは排除できないと公共放送ＥＲＲに語った。

item.title: Un buque de carga ruso ha sido atacado por drones en el Golfo de Finlandia
item.description: Rusia ha afirmado que un buque de carga con destino a su enclave de Kaliningrado fue objeto de un ataque en aguas internacionales del golfo de Finlandia.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Rusia ha afirmado que un buque de carga con destino a su enclave de Kaliningrado fue objeto de un ataque en aguas internacionales del golfo de Finlandia, lo que pone de relieve los crecientes riesgos para las exportaciones energéticas y alimentarias del país a través de las rutas marítimas clave del mar Báltico. Dos drones atacaron el buque a unas tres millas náuticas de la frontera marítima de Rusia, según ha declarado en Telegram el gobernador de la región de Leningrado, Alexander Drozdenko. El Ministerio de Defensa de Finlandia ha informado de que se ha enviado a la guardia fronteriza al lugar del incidente, al oeste de Suursaari —conocida en Rusia como Gogland—, en la parte oriental del golfo de Finlandia. Se están aplicando restricciones temporales a la navegación aérea y marítima como medida de precaución. El buque, el “Sparta II”, quedó a la deriva en aguas finlandesas tras ser alcanzado y prenderse fuego. La tripulación ha sido evacuada a un buque de carga cercano, según informó la guardia fronteriza del país nórdico. Varias unidades finlandesas y un buque estonio están combatiendo el incendio. El buque de rescate ruso “Murman” también participa en las operaciones de rescate a petición de la guardia fronteriza finlandesa. Finlandia ha indicado que el plan consiste en permitir el remolque del buque averiado hasta aguas rusas. Rusia no ha facilitado más detalles y Ucrania no ha hecho comentarios al respecto. El buque estaba vinculado al ejército ruso y podría haber transportado material militar, según informó el diario “Helsingin Sanomat”, citando a la guardia fronteriza finlandesa. La carga no ha sido verificada, según declaró la guardia fronteriza al periódico con sede en Helsinki. Se trata del segundo buque alcanzado por un dron este mes en el golfo de Finlandia, a medida que las operaciones militares de Ucrania se han extendido a una nueva zona alejada de su frontera con Rusia. La corbeta “Naro-Fominsk”, de la clase “Buyan-M” de la Armada rusa, fue alcanzada el 11 de noviembre como parte de un bombardeo contra Ust-Luga, un importante centro de exportación del Báltico. Por otra parte, Finlandia afirmó que se sospecha que un helicóptero ruso violó su espacio aéreo el sábado por la tarde en las afueras de la localidad de Loviisa, en el golfo de Finlandia. “Los sucesos relacionados con el buque Sparta II en el golfo de Finlandia son graves”, declaró el presidente finlandés, Alexander Stubb, en una publicación en X. El mar Báltico, de aguas poco profundas y rocosas, es una de las vías navegables más transitadas del mundo, por la que transita cada año alrededor del 15% del transporte marítimo de mercancías mundial. Más de tres millones de personas cruzan el golfo de Finlandia en transbordadores de pasajeros cada año, y por él también transitan buques de carga y petroleros, incluida la “flota en la sombra” que transporta petróleo ruso sujeto a sanciones. La región, donde se encuentran varios de los puertos bálticos más grandes de Rusia, también fue objeto de un gran ataque con drones, en el que se derribaron 80 drones ucranianos, según el gobernador. Los ataques con drones del 11 de noviembre en Ust-Luga también causaron daños en la terminal de productos petrolíferos de Novatek PJSC, incluidos los tanques de almacenamiento, así como en la infraestructura de la terminal de productos petrolíferos de Ust-Luga, según informó en su momento el Servicio de Seguridad de Ucrania. Ust-Luga se encuentra a más de 1.000 km al norte de Kiev. Los puertos del Báltico son vitales para las exportaciones rusas de crudo y productos petrolíferos. Su papel en el comercio de combustibles también ha cobrado importancia tras el acuerdo alcanzado en octubre entre el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, y el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, que permitió a Rusia reanudar parcialmente las exportaciones de gasóleo. Un primer buque cisterna cargado de gasóleo zarpó del puerto báltico de Primorsk en octubre, lo que supuso la reanudación de los envíos marítimos tras el levantamiento parcial de la prohibición de exportación por parte de Moscú. Las rutas del mar Báltico también han cobrado cada vez más importancia para los envíos de cereales, ya que los ataques interrumpen el transporte marítimo tanto desde el sur de Rusia como desde Ucrania. Los puertos del Báltico gestionaron el 65,3% de las exportaciones marítimas de cereales de Rusia en octubre, con un aumento de los envíos de 8,7 veces respecto al año anterior, mientras que los volúmenes de los puertos del mar de Azov y del mar Negro se desplomaron, según la Unión Rusa de Cereales. Ust-Luga fue el mayor puerto exportador de cereales del país durante ese mes, con un volumen de 684.000 toneladas. Por otra parte, el sábado, las autoridades ucranianas afirmaron que las fuerzas rusas lanzaron durante la noche tres misiles balísticos y 148 drones contra diversos objetivos, de los cuales 117 fueron derribados. El presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, declaró el X que se están llevando a cabo esfuerzos para hacer frente a las consecuencias de un ataque ruso perpetrado a última hora del viernes contra Kyrvyi Rih, su ciudad natal, que se saldó con dos fallecidos, entre ellos un niño pequeño, y al menos 60 heridos. --Con la colaboración de Kati Pohjanpalo.

HELSINKI: A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday ( Nov 21) and later drifted into Finnish waters, prompting Helsinki to impose temporary air and maritime restrictions and say Ukraine was probably behind the attack. The Sparta II, bound for Russian exclave Kaliningrad , was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland 's Defence Forces said, corroborating an earlier account by Russian officials. "It is likely that Ukraine...is behind (the attack)," Finnish armed forces spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen told a press conference, adding it was not clear why the vessel had been targeted. Finland 's Border Guard said there was no danger to maritime traffic or people, that rescue units were at the scene, and that it was coordinating operations with neighbouring countries.
